stem: Which quotation from this letter reveals the main reason for the surge in Irish immigration to the United States in the mid-nineteenth century?

options.label: F
options.text: “I am exceedingly well pleased at coming to this land of plenty.”

options.label: G
options.text: “I would advise all my friends to quit Ireland. . . .”

options.label: H
options.text: “What you labour for is sweetened by contentment and happiness. . . .”

options.label: J
options.text: “There is no failure in the potato crop. . . .”

visual_elements: Letter from an Irish immigrant to The Times of London, May 14, 1850
